description: This file defines a mock database for notification style demo data in an Android application. It contains static methods to retrieve instances of various notification style data classes, which are also defined within. The classes provide sample data for BigTextStyle, BigPictureStyle, InboxStyle, and MessagingStyle notifications, with singleton pattern implementations and accessor methods.

classes.name: MockDatabase
classes.description: A utility class providing static access methods to various mock notification data objects used for demo purposes.

classes.name: BigTextStyleReminderAppData
classes.description: Contains sample data for BigTextStyle notifications, implemented as a singleton.

classes.name: BigPictureStyleSocialAppData
classes.description: Contains sample data for BigPictureStyle notifications, including images and responses, implemented as a singleton.

classes.name: InboxStyleEmailAppData
classes.description: Contains sample data for InboxStyle email notifications, including multiple email summaries, implemented as a singleton.

classes.name: MessagingStyleCommsAppData
classes.description: Contains sample data for MessagingStyle notifications representing chat messages, including message lists and participant info, implemented as a singleton.
